You write one complete single-file HTML5 mini-game and store it with the `save_draft` tool.

Rules you cannot break:

- The page is one HTML document: doctype, `<html lang>` matching the plan's language, a viewport meta tag, inline `<style>` and classic inline `<script>` only.
- No network, no storage, no dialogs, no `eval`, no module scripts, no external URLs. Draw every visual in code.
- Include the `CARTRIDGE` helper from the bridge card exactly as written, and send the bridge events the type card requires, in the order it describes.
- Listen for host commands (`pause`, `resume`, `reset`) as the bridge card shows.

How to work:

- The plan and the cards you need are in the message. Call `get_card` only if you need a card that is not included.
- Write the whole page, then call `save_draft` once with the full HTML. Never send a partial page.
- When the message lists failed rules, call `load_draft` first, fix every listed rule in that draft, keep what already works, and save the whole page again with `save_draft`.
- After saving, reply with one short sentence. Do not paste the page into your reply; only the saved draft counts.

content.text:
## Plan

```json
{
  "title": "Kite on the Wind",
  "slug": "kite-on-the-wind",
  "lang": "en",
  "gameType": "arcade-run",
  "loop": "Tap to make the paper kite rise on the wind, dodging rooftop chimneys and collecting ribbons as the breeze speeds up. Hitting a chimney ends the flight and shows your ribbon count.",
  "input": "tap-anywhere",
  "style": "paper-cut"
}
```

## Cards

### Card `arcade-run`

# Arcade run

The world scrolls on its own, the player dodges and gathers, and one mistake ends the run.

## Contract row

| field                | value         |
| -------------------- | ------------- |
| score                | `required`    |
| level                | `forbidden`   |
| end                  | `required`    |
| end reasons          | `lose`        |
| reset                | `soft`        |
| idle death gate      | `min-seconds` |
| idle motion required | `yes`         |

- Emit every event marked `required` above at least once: `score` as points change and `end` when the run is over. <!-- rule:E1-15 -->
- Never emit an event marked `forbidden`. A run has no levels, so ramp difficulty with speed instead. <!-- rule:E1-16 -->
- The only allowed `end` reason is `lose`. <!-- rule:E1-17 -->

## Fairness

A player who does nothing must survive for a few seconds after `start`. Spawn the first hazard well ahead of the player and keep the opening lane clear.

## Loop skeleton

```js
let last = 0,
  running = false,
  paused = false,
  score = 0;
function frame(now) {
  const dt = Math.min((now - last) / 1000, 0.05);
  last = now;
  if (running && !paused) {
    advance(dt);
    collide();
  }
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
function crash() {
  running = false;
  CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "lose", value: score });
}
```

Keep something moving on screen while idle (clouds, a pulsing prompt) so the run never looks frozen.

### Card `bridge`

# Bridge

Games talk to the host only through `postMessage`. Paste this helper verbatim before any game code:

```js
const CARTRIDGE = {
  send(type, payload = {}) {
    window.parent.postMessage(
      { source: "cartridge", v: 1, type, payload },
      "*",
    );
  },
};
```

The helper must be named `CARTRIDGE` and must stamp `source: "cartridge"` and `v: 1` on every message. <!-- rule:E1-10 -->

## Game to host

| event   | payload                              | when                                 |
| ------- | ------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------ |
| `boot`  | `{ title, gameType, lang }`          | once, after the first frame is drawn |
| `start` | `{}`                                 | when play begins                     |
| `score` | `{ value }`, an integer of 0 or more | whenever the score changes           |
| `level` | `{ index }`, starting at 1, then +1  | on entering each level               |
| `end`   | `{ reason, value? }`                 | once per play-through                |

- Send `boot` with all three keys: `CARTRIDGE.send("boot", { title, gameType, lang })`. <!-- rule:E1-11 -->
- When `boot.lang` is written as a literal, it must equal the `lang` on `<html>`. <!-- rule:E1-12 -->
- Emit `CARTRIDGE.send("start")` when play begins. <!-- rule:E1-13 -->
- Write `boot.gameType` as a string literal naming one of the four game types; it must match the planned type. <!-- rule:E1-14 -->
- Pass `score.value` as a number, never a quoted string. <!-- rule:E1-18 -->
- Give every `level` call an `index` key: `CARTRIDGE.send("level", { index: stage })`. <!-- rule:E1-19 -->

## Host to game

Commands arrive as `{ source: "cartridge-host", type }` with `type` one of `pause`, `resume` or `reset`. Ignore anything with another `source`.

- Listen with `window.addEventListener("message", …)` and handle `pause` and `resume`: freeze and restart the loop without losing state. <!-- rule:E1-20 -->
- Handle `reset` by returning to the pre-`start` screen without reloading the page. <!-- rule:E1-21 -->

```js
window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
  const data = event.data;
  if (!data || data.source !== "cartridge-host") return;
  if (data.type === "pause") paused = true;
  if (data.type === "resume") paused = false;
  if (data.type === "reset") backToTitle();
});
```

### Card `game-page`

# Game page

A cartridge is one self-contained HTML file. The host loads it into a sandboxed iframe with scripts allowed and no same-origin access.

## Document

- Start with a single `<!doctype html>` and wrap everything in one `<html>…</html>`. Never embed another `<iframe>`. <!-- rule:E1-01 -->
- Put the UI language on the root element, for example `<html lang="fr">`: a two- or three-letter primary subtag with an optional region. <!-- rule:E1-03 -->
- Add `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">` in the head. <!-- rule:E1-04 -->

## Self-contained

- Load nothing from outside the file: no `http:`, `https:` or `//` URL in `src`, `href`, CSS `url()`, `@import` or `import()`. Inline `data:` URIs are fine. <!-- rule:E1-02 -->
- Draw every sprite, tile and glyph in code (canvas paths or inline SVG). Use system fonts.

## Forbidden APIs

- Do not open a network connection: no `fetch(`, `XMLHttpRequest`, `WebSocket`, `EventSource` or `sendBeacon`. <!-- rule:E1-05 -->
- Do not persist anything: `localStorage`, `sessionStorage`, `indexedDB` and `document.cookie` all throw inside the sandbox. <!-- rule:E1-06 -->
- Do not build code at runtime: no `eval(`, no `new Function(`, and pass functions, not strings, to `setTimeout` and `setInterval`. <!-- rule:E1-07 -->
- Avoid blocking dialogs (`alert(`, `confirm(`, `prompt(`); draw messages on the canvas instead. <!-- rule:E1-08 -->

## Scripts

- Use classic inline `<script>` blocks only, never `type="module"`, and make sure each one parses on its own. <!-- rule:E1-09 -->
- Keep one script for the bridge helper and one for the game, or merge them. Order matters: the helper must exist first.

## Layout

- Fill the viewport and react when it changes: listen for `resize`, read `innerWidth`/`innerHeight`, or size with `dvh`/`vw` units. <!-- rule:E1-23 -->
- Scale the canvas by `devicePixelRatio` so lines stay crisp on phones.
- Keep touch targets at least 44 CSS pixels on the short edge.

### Card `paper-cut`

# Paper cut

Everything looks cut from coloured card and stacked in layers.

## Palette

| role       | colour    |
| ---------- | --------- |
| background | `#f4ecd8` |
| layer      | `#e07a5f` |
| accent     | `#3d405b` |
| highlight  | `#81b29a` |

## Primitives

- Filled paths with slightly irregular edges: jitter each vertex by one or two pixels, seeded once so it does not flicker.
- One soft shadow per layer: `shadowBlur` around 6 and a small downward offset.
- Rounded rectangles and circles for pieces; stacked copies offset by a few pixels suggest depth.
- Text in a heavy system sans-serif, drawn on a card-shaped plate.

## Avoid

- Gradients, glows and outlines thicker than two pixels.
- Pure black; use the accent colour for the darkest tone.
- Photographic textures or anything loaded from a file.

### Card `tap-anywhere`

# Tap anywhere

The whole screen is the button. Best for jumps, flaps and single choices.

- Register pointer input on the canvas: `canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", onTap)`. <!-- rule:E1-22 -->
- Call `event.preventDefault()` and set `touch-action: none` on the canvas so the page does not scroll or zoom.
- The first tap after `boot` starts play and sends `start`; later taps perform the action.
- Ignore taps while paused.

```js
canvas.style.touchAction = "none";
canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
  event.preventDefault();
  if (paused) return;
  if (!running) {
    running = true;
    CARTRIDGE.send("start");
    return;
  }
  act();
});
```

Show a short pulsing hint ("Tap to begin") until the first tap.

## Task

Write the complete game page for this plan and save it with `save_draft`.
Now I'll build the complete game page following all the cards' requirements.

input.html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Kite on the Wind</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    background: #f4ecd8;
    overflow: hidden;
    touch-action: none;
  }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100dvh;
    touch-action: none;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
// ---- Bridge helper (verbatim) ----
const CARTRIDGE = {
  send(type, payload = {}) {
    window.parent.postMessage(
      { source: "cartridge", v: 1, type, payload },
      "*",
    );
  },
};
</script>
<script>
(function () {
  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

  let dpr = Math.max(1, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
  let W = 0, H = 0;

  function resize() {
    W = window.innerWidth;
    H = window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width = Math.floor(W * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.floor(H * dpr);
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
  }
  window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
  resize();

  // ---- seeded jitter helper for paper-cut look ----
  function seededRandom(seed) {
    let s = seed % 2147483647;
    if (s <= 0) s += 2147483646;
    return function () {
      s = (s * 16807) % 2147483647;
      return (s - 1) / 2147483646;
    };
  }
  const jitterRand = seededRandom(12345);
  function jitter(v, amt) {
    return v + (jitterRand() - 0.5) * amt;
  }

  const PALETTE = {
    background: "#f4ecd8",
    layer: "#e07a5f",
    accent: "#3d405b",
    highlight: "#81b29a",
  };

  // ---- game state ----
  let last = 0,
    running = false,
    paused = false,
    started = false,
    score = 0;

  let kiteY = 0, kiteVy = 0;
  const kiteX = 0.28; // fraction of width
  const gravity = 620;
  const flapImpulse = -300;
  const maxFall = 480;

  let scrollSpeed = 160;
  const baseSpeed = 160;
  let elapsed = 0;

  let obstacles = []; // chimneys {x, gapY, gapH, w, passed}
  let ribbons = []; // {x, y, r, taken}

  let clouds = [];

  let tapHintPulse = 0;

  function initClouds() {
    clouds = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      clouds.push({
        x: Math.random() * 1,
        y: 0.05 + Math.random() * 0.35,
        s: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.8,
        speed: 0.02 + Math.random() * 0.03,
      });
    }
  }
  initClouds();

  function resetState() {
    running = false;
    started = false;
    paused = false;
    score = 0;
    kiteY = H * 0.5;
    kiteVy = 0;
    scrollSpeed = baseSpeed;
    elapsed = 0;
    obstacles = [];
    ribbons = [];
    spawnInitialObstacle();
  }

  function spawnInitialObstacle() {
    // Fairness: keep opening lane clear, first hazard well ahead
    obstacles.push(makeObstacle(W + W * 0.9));
  }

  function makeObstacle(x) {
    const gapH = Math.max(H * 0.28, 170);
    const margin = H * 0.12;
    const gapY = margin + Math.random() * (H - gapH - margin * 2);
    return {
      x: x,
      w: 62,
      gapY: gapY,
      gapH: gapH,
      passed: false,
    };
  }

  function maybeSpawnRibbon(obstacleX, gapY, gapH) {
    if (Math.random() < 0.85) {
      ribbons.push({
        x: obstacleX + 120 + Math.random() * 60,
        y: gapY + gapH / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * gapH * 0.3,
        r: 14,
        taken: false,
      });
    }
  }

  function backToTitle() {
    resetState();
  }

  function act() {
    kiteVy = flapImpulse;
  }

  // ---- input ----
  canvas.style.touchAction = "none";
  canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (paused) return;
    if (!running) {
      running = true;
      started = true;
      CARTRIDGE.send("start");
      return;
    }
    act();
  });

  // ---- host messages ----
  window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
    const data = event.data;
    if (!data || data.source !== "cartridge-host") return;
    if (data.type === "pause") paused = true;
    if (data.type === "resume") paused = false;
    if (data.type === "reset") backToTitle();
  });

  function advance(dt) {
    elapsed += dt;
    // ramp difficulty with speed over time
    scrollSpeed = baseSpeed + Math.min(elapsed * 4.5, 160);

    kiteVy += gravity * dt;
    if (kiteVy > maxFall) kiteVy = maxFall;
    kiteY += kiteVy * dt;

    if (kiteY < 20) {
      kiteY = 20;
      kiteVy = 0;
    }
    if (kiteY > H - 20) {
      kiteY = H - 20;
      // still allowed to fly, but let's not force crash on floor; kite bumps back
      kiteVy = 0;
    }

    for (const o of obstacles) {
      o.x -= scrollSpeed * dt;
    }
    for (const r of ribbons) {
      r.x -= scrollSpeed * dt;
    }

    // spawn new obstacles
    if (obstacles.length === 0 || obstacles[obstacles.length - 1].x < W - 320) {
      const newX = (obstacles.length ? obstacles[obstacles.length - 1].x : W) + 320 + Math.random() * 100;
      const o = makeObstacle(newX);
      obstacles.push(o);
      maybeSpawnRibbon(o.x, o.gapY, o.gapH);
    }

    // remove offscreen
    obstacles = obstacles.filter((o) => o.x + o.w > -20);
    ribbons = ribbons.filter((r) => r.x > -40);

    // score for passing obstacles
    const px = W * kiteX;
    for (const o of obstacles) {
      if (!o.passed && o.x + o.w < px) {
        o.passed = true;
        score += 1;
        CARTRIDGE.send("score", { value: score });
      }
    }

    // ribbon collection
    for (const r of ribbons) {
      if (r.taken) continue;
      const dx = r.x - px;
      const dy = r.y - kiteY;
      const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
      if (dist < r.r + 16) {
        r.taken = true;
        score += 3;
        CARTRIDGE.send("score", { value: score });
      }
    }
    ribbons = ribbons.filter((r) => !r.taken);

    // clouds drift
    for (const c of clouds) {
      c.x -= c.speed * dt * 0.6;
      if (c.x < -0.2) c.x = 1.2;
    }
  }

  function collide() {
    const px = W * kiteX;
    const kiteR = 16;
    for (const o of obstacles) {
      if (px + kiteR > o.x && px - kiteR < o.x + o.w) {
        if (kiteY - kiteR < o.gapY || kiteY + kiteR > o.gapY + o.gapH) {
          crash();
          return;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  function crash() {
    running = false;
    CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "lose", value: score });
  }

  // ---- drawing (paper-cut style) ----
  function roundedRectPath(x, y, w, h, r, jitterAmt) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    const pts = [
      [x + r, y],
      [x + w - r, y],
      [x + w, y + r],
      [x + w, y + h - r],
      [x + w - r, y + h],
      [x + r, y + h],
      [x, y + h - r],
      [x, y + r],
    ];
    ctx.moveTo(jitter(pts[0][0], jitterAmt), jitter(pts[0][1], jitterAmt));
    ctx.arcTo(jitter(x + w, jitterAmt), jitter(y, jitterAmt), jitter(x + w, jitterAmt), jitter(y + h, jitterAmt), r);
    ctx.arcTo(jitter(x + w, jitterAmt), jitter(y + h, jitterAmt), jitter(x, jitterAmt), jitter(y + h, jitterAmt), r);
    ctx.arcTo(jitter(x, jitterAmt), jitter(y + h, jitterAmt), jitter(x, jitterAmt), jitter(y, jitterAmt), r);
    ctx.arcTo(jitter(x, jitterAmt), jitter(y, jitterAmt), jitter(x + w, jitterAmt), jitter(y, jitterAmt), r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function drawBackground() {
    ctx.fillStyle = PALETTE.background;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // clouds - soft paper shapes
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(61,64,91,0.15)";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
    ctx.shadowOffsetY = 2;
    for (const c of clouds) {
      const cx = c.x * W;
      const cy = c.y * H;
      const s = c.s * 40;
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(jitter(cx, 2), jitter(cy, 2), s, s * 0.6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.ellipse(jitter(cx + s * 0.7, 2), jitter(cy + 4, 2), s * 0.7, s * 0.45, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.ellipse(jitter(cx - s * 0.6, 2), jitter(cy + 6, 2), s * 0.6, s * 0.4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawObstacle(o) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(61,64,91,0.25)";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
    ctx.shadowOffsetY = 3;
    ctx.fillStyle = PALETTE.layer;

    // top chimney
    roundedRectPath(o.x, 0, o.w, o.gapY, 6, 1.5);
    ctx.fill();

    // bottom chimney
    roundedRectPath(o.x, o.gapY + o.gapH, o.w, H - (o.gapY + o.gapH), 6, 1.5);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.restore();

    // accent cap details
    ctx.fillStyle = PALETTE.accent;
    ctx.fillRect(jitter(o.x - 4, 1), jitter(o.gapY - 14, 1), o.w + 8, 14);
    ctx.fillRect(jitter(o.x - 4, 1), jitter(o.gapY + o.gapH, 1), o.w + 8, 14);
  }

  function drawRibbon(r) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(61,64,91,0.2)";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 5;
    ctx.shadowOffsetY = 2;
    ctx.fillStyle = PALETTE.highlight;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(jitter(r.x, 1.5), jitter(r.y - r.r, 1.5));
    ctx.lineTo(jitter(r.x + r.r, 1.5), jitter(r.y, 1.5));
    ctx.lineTo(jitter(r.x, 1.5), jitter(r.y + r.r, 1.5));
    ctx.lineTo(jitter(r.x - r.r, 1.5), jitter(r.y, 1.5));
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();

    // little tail
    ctx.strokeStyle = PALETTE.highlight;
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(r.x, r.y + r.r);
    ctx.lineTo(r.x - 4, r.y + r.r + 10);
    ctx.moveTo(r.x, r.y + r.r);
    ctx.lineTo(r.x + 4, r.y + r.r + 10);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  function drawKite(x, y) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(61,64,91,0.3)";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
    ctx.shadowOffsetY = 3;

    const angle = Math.max(-0.5, Math.min(0.5, kiteVy / 400));

    ctx.translate(x, y);
    ctx.rotate(angle);

    // kite body: diamond shape stacked layers
    ctx.fillStyle = PALETTE.accent;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(jitter(0, 1.5), jitter(-26, 1.5));
    ctx.lineTo(jitter(20, 1.5), jitter(0, 1.5));
    ctx.lineTo(jitter(0, 1.5), jitter(30, 1.5));
    ctx.lineTo(jitter(-20, 1.5), jitter(0, 1.5));
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = PALETTE.layer;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(jitter(0, 1.5), jitter(-20, 1.5));
    ctx.lineTo(jitter(14, 1.5), jitter(0, 1.5));
    ctx.lineTo(jitter(0, 1.5), jitter(22, 1.5));
    ctx.lineTo(jitter(-14, 1.5), jitter(0, 1.5));
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.restore();

    // tail ribbons
    ctx.strokeStyle = PALETTE.highlight;
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    const tailWobble = Math.sin(elapsed * 6) * 6;
    ctx.moveTo(x, y + 28);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x - 10 + tailWobble, y + 45, x - 4, y + 60);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  function drawCard(text, subtext, y) {
    ctx.save();
    const cardW = Math.min(340, W * 0.8);
    const cardH = 120;
    const cx = W / 2 - cardW / 2;
    const cy = y - cardH / 2;
    ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(61,64,91,0.25)";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
    ctx.shadowOffsetY = 3;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    roundedRectPath(cx, cy, cardW, cardH, 14, 1.5);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();

    ctx.fillStyle = PALETTE.accent;
    ctx.font = "bold 26px system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText(text, W / 2, cy + 42);

    ctx.font = "16px system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(subtext, W / 2, cy + 78);
  }

  function drawScoreBadge() {
    ctx.save();
    const w = 90, h = 40;
    ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(61,64,91,0.2)";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 5;
    ctx.shadowOffsetY = 2;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    roundedRectPath(16, 16, w, h, 10, 1);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();

    ctx.fillStyle = PALETTE.accent;
    ctx.font = "bold 20px system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText("★ " + score, 16 + w / 2, 16 + h / 2 + 1);
  }

  function draw() {
    drawBackground();

    if (!started) {
      // idle prompt, kite gently bobbing so it never looks frozen
      const bob = Math.sin(elapsed * 2) * 10;
      drawKite(W * kiteX, H * 0.5 + bob);
      tapHintPulse += 0.05;
      const alpha = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(tapHintPulse * 2);
      ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
      drawCard("Kite on the Wind", "Tap to begin", H * 0.72);
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      ctx.fillStyle = PALETTE.accent;
      ctx.font = "bold 30px system-ui, sans-serif";
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      return;
    }

    for (const o of obstacles) drawObstacle(o);
    for (const r of ribbons) drawRibbon(r);
    drawKite(W * kiteX, kiteY);
    drawScoreBadge();

    if (!running) {
      drawCard("Flight Over", "Ribbons: " + score + " — tap to fly again", H * 0.42);
    }

    if (paused) {
      drawCard("Paused", "Waiting...", H * 0.5);
    }
  }

  // ---- restart after crash via tap ----
  canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
    if (paused) return;
    if (started && !running) {
      // small delay handled naturally: just reset and immediately treat as new start
      resetState();
      running = true;
      started = true;
      CARTRIDGE.send("start");
    }
  });

  function frame(now) {
    const dt = Math.min((now - last) / 1000, 0.05);
    last = now;
    if (running && !paused) {
      advance(dt);
      collide();
    } else if (!started) {
      elapsed += dt;
      for (const c of clouds) {
        c.x -= c.speed * dt * 0.6;
        if (c.x < -0.2) c.x = 1.2;
      }
    }
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  // init
  resetState();
  requestAnimationFrame((t) => {
    last = t;
    draw();
    CARTRIDGE.send("boot", { title: "Kite on the Wind", gameType: "arcade-run", lang: "en" });
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
